_readme: Rules for .github/workflows/seo-automerge.yml. Read from the default branch only. A pull request from a fix/seo-* or blog/* branch merges on its own when the Vercel build passes and every changed file matches allow, matches no deny, and the size limits hold. The workflow also has a built-in list that is never auto-merged (workflows, package files, config, env, API routes, scripts). Set enabled to false to hold every pull request of that kind for a person.
